headline: Advance Booking Required for Castillo Entry and State Parks
reservation: Entry to the Castillo de San Marcos National Monument is subject to capacity; check the official NPS site for the latest ticketing system. Accommodation at Anastasia State Park often requires booking months ahead via the Florida State Parks portal. Distinguish between historic site entry fees and separate glamping or hotel reservations, which must be verified with individual providers.

days.title: Colonial History and Ancient Fortifications
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM at Castillo de San Marcos

stops.name: Castillo de San Marcos
stops.detail: Explore the coquina walls and ramparts of this 17th-century Spanish stone fortress.

stops.name: St. George Street
stops.detail: Walk the pedestrian-only thoroughfare through the heart of the colonial historic district.

days.driving: Walking itinerary; parking in the historic core is limited and often paid.
days.note: Arrive at the fort early to avoid the midday Florida humidity.

days.title: Maritime Views and Barrier Island Nature
days.start: Suggested: 9:30 AM from the Bridge of Lions

stops.name: St. Augustine Lighthouse
stops.detail: Climb the tower for panoramic views of the Atlantic and maritime museum exhibits.

stops.name: Anastasia State Park
stops.detail: Kayak the Salt Run or walk the protected dunes of this maritime hammock ecosystem.

days.driving: Allow 15–20 minutes to cross the bridge; traffic varies by season.
days.note: Check the tide charts if you plan to explore the beach flats at Anastasia.

days.title: Coastal Research and Hidden Shores
days.start: Suggested: 8:30 AM heading North on A1A

stops.name: GTM Research Reserve
stops.detail: Hike the rugged trails through maritime forests and hunt for shark teeth on the beach.

stops.name: Vilano Beach Pier
stops.detail: View the city skyline from across the water at this laid-back coastal community.

days.driving: Allow 20 minutes from downtown to the GTM Reserve; traffic is lighter north of the city.
days.note: Bring insect repellent for the maritime forest trails, especially at dusk.

intel.title: Historic District Constraints
intel.text: Public lots near the fort fill by mid-morning; use the Historic Downtown Parking Facility for easier access. Street parking is strictly monitored and limited to specific time durations.

intel.title: Coastal Connectivity
intel.text: Cell service is strong in the city but can be spotty within the GTM Research Reserve's northern trails. Expect reliable signals at the Lighthouse and Anastasia Island commercial areas.

intel.title: Mainland vs. Island Fuel
intel.text: Gas stations are plentiful along US-1 and the entry to Anastasia Island. Fuel is more difficult to find on the remote stretches of A1A leading north toward Ponte Vedra.

intel.title: Seasonal Heat Management
intel.text: The warmest months are June through August; plan outdoor sightseeing for early morning. Daily thunderstorms are common in summer; carry a light rain jacket for sudden coastal showers.

intel.title: Drawbridge Delays
intel.text: The Bridge of Lions opens on a schedule for boat traffic, which can cause significant vehicle delays. Check the local bridge opening times if you have a scheduled tour or airport departure.

plan.arrival: Arrive at Northeast Florida Regional Airport (UST) and pick up your rental for the 14-minute drive to the historic district; alternatively, use regional shuttles.
plan.vehicle: A standard car is sufficient; large RVs are difficult to maneuver and park in the narrow streets of the colonial district.
plan.goldenHour: The Vilano Beach Pier offers a clear westward view of the St. Augustine skyline during the evening sunset.
